note: INTENTIONAL METERING GAP -- DO NOT 'FIX'. Sub-meters are installed on the MCC-001 and MCC-002 feeders and on the DB-003 critical-loads feeder, but the MCC-003 feeder (utilities and HVAC: chillers, air compressor, pumps and drive-fed motor) is DELIBERATELY left without a dedicated sub-meter. This creates a real unmetered load path: the whole-plant / LV-board meters capture the total, yet no sub-meter directly measures MCC-003, so an energy balance leaves a non-zero residual. It is a deliberate test fixture for the WP3 unmetered-load detector and MUST NOT be 'corrected' by adding an MTR-MCC-003 meter.
